strongest_verified_claim: Every neighborhoodwise Korevaar–Schoen-energy-minimizing map in the source W1,2(S2,X) framework, with complete X, is infinitesimally (4+sqrt(17))-quasiconformal.
scope: Full cited metric-Sobolev framework; no extra smooth-target/proper-target/nondegeneracy restriction.
mechanism: Smooth angular pushforward density gives a unique tracefree KS stress. Local smooth competitors give divergence-free stress. It glues to a holomorphic quadratic differential on the sphere and vanishes. A rank-one comparison quantitatively excludes seminorm degeneracy.

checks.claim: Angular substitution, differentiability of arbitrary nonsmooth seminorm density
checks.evidence: Independent algebra and direct/inverse circle controls; all finite-order derivatives dominated by C_k M^2.

checks.claim: Exact local minimizing quantifier and same-trace competitor
checks.evidence: Compactly supported fields inside fixed minimizing chart; self-diffeomorphisms for both signs; equality on boundary collar; scalar Sobolev composition.
Measurable source seminorm field, M^2 energy integrability, fixed-field substitution and uniform matrix-kernel bounds; no common uncountable parameter null set needed.

checks.claim: Variable coefficients and variable differential field
checks.evidence: Conformal quadratic-density/area cancellation; exact rational direct-vs-fixed-field derivative −128/45.

checks.claim: Holomorphic stress covariance and global sphere vanishing
checks.evidence: CR equations, q_w=(dz/dw)^2 q_z, local minimizing neighborhoods at both poles, Liouville decay O(|z|^-4).
Whole tensor vanishes a.e.; minimum direction selected only within the pointwise seminorm lemma, no measurable direction field required.
Zero trivial; nonzero degenerate excluded by m>=sqrt(17)-4; rank-one moments and comparison norm <=8m.

standard_inputs: Existence and measurability of approximate metric differential for source essentially separably valued complete-target Sobolev maps
Source seminorm energy representation and M^2 integrability
Scalar Sobolev composition under smooth biLipschitz changes; approximate chain rule also reconstructed directly
Distributional Weyl regularity for dbar and Liouville theorem
limitations: Numerical integration controls do not prove universal analytic claims
Final publisher full text not examined
